<thought>To obtain a Doebner‑type condensation template we must search for a reaction that breaks an aldehyde and forms both a C‑C double bond and an aliphatic carboxylic acid (the α,β‑unsaturated acid product). The catalog accepts the functional‑group names “aliphatic carboxylic acid” and “C‑C double bonds”. I will query with both of these as formed groups.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
